Democrats have scored a major victory in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, dealing a significant setback to Donald Trump and the Republican Party. The results could reshape Trump's domestic agenda and influence U.S. policies on Iran, Ukraine, Russia and China. What could the Democratic wave mean for immigration, trade and India-US relations? In this episode of WorldView, we examine the global impact of the midterms and India's room to manoeuvre in geopolitics.
Thank you for watching our video!
